name: Umamusume: Glorious Pair Derby
source: Pony girls are very popular all over the world. Crowds of spectators come to watch their races! And you are one of them! But you have completely different goals. You place large bets in the hope of getting rich. But unfortunately, victory is not always on your side. So you decide to talk to the ponies and boost their motivation to win. You promise to share the profits with them. Pony girls are very emotional. They are overly confident, but they can also easily lose faith in themselves. But you don’t care about that. All you want from them is victory! But if they lose… Then they will have to work off their defeat in front of you…
